theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.polDict_i_circular {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] :
hopf (polDict 0 1 1 1) = { re := 0, imI := 0, imJ := -2, imK := 0 }

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.polDict_one_linear {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] :
(hopf (polDict 1 0 1 1)).imJ = 0

BringCone R

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_pol_v2_axis {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (c d : R) :
hopf (pol 0 0 c d) = -((c * c + d * d) • unitI)

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_pol_v1_axis {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a b : R) :
hopf (pol a b 0 0) = (a * a + b * b) • unitI

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_circular_minus {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] :
hopf (pol 1 0 0 (-1)) = { re := 0, imI := 0, imJ := 2, imK := 0 }

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_circular_plus {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] :
hopf (pol 1 0 0 1) = { re := 0, imI := 0, imJ := -2, imK := 0 }

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_re {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (p : BringCone R) :
(hopf p).re = 0

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_real_imJ {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a c : R) :
(hopf (pol a 0 c 0)).imJ = 0

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.orth_pair_swap_is_flip {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {p₁ p₂ : BringCone R} (hp₁ : Quaternion.normSq p₁ = 1) (hp₂ : Quaternion.normSq p₂ = 1) (hre : (star p₁ * p₂).re = 0) (hi : (star p₁ * p₂).imI = 0) (x : BringCone R) :
chiralGammaU (hopf p₂) x = -chiralGammaU (hopf p₁) x

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.orth_pair_chirality {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {p₁ p₂ : BringCone R} (hp₁ : Quaternion.normSq p₁ = 1) (hp₂ : Quaternion.normSq p₂ = 1) (hre : (star p₁ * p₂).re = 0) (hi : (star p₁ * p₂).imI = 0) :
chiralGammaU (hopf p₁) p₁ = -p₁ ∧ chiralGammaU (hopf p₁) p₂ = p₂

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_orth {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {p₁ p₂ : BringCone R} (hp₁ : Quaternion.normSq p₁ = 1) (hre : (star p₁ * p₂).re = 0) (hi : (star p₁ * p₂).imI = 0) :
hopf p₂ = -(((star p₁ * p₂).imJ * (star p₁ * p₂).imJ + (star p₁ * p₂).imK * (star p₁ * p₂).imK) • hopf p₁)

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.orth_conj_unitI {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (c d : R) :
orthW c d * unitI * star (orthW c d) = -((c * c + d * d) • unitI)

def QOU.Tetraplectic.orthW {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (c d : R) :
BringCone R

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_eq_ray {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (h2 : ∀ (x : R), 2 * x = 0 → x = 0) {p p' : BringCone R} (hp : Quaternion.normSq p = 1) (hp' : Quaternion.normSq p' = 1) (h : hopf p = hopf p') :
(star p * p').imJ = 0 ∧ (star p * p').imK = 0 ∧ p' = p * (star p * p')

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_eigen_line {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {p : BringCone R} (hp : Quaternion.normSq p = 1) (a b : R) :
chiralGammaU (hopf p) (p * cplx a b) = -(p * cplx a b)

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_leftMul {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (g p : BringCone R) :
hopf (g * p) = conjBy g (hopf p)

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_mul_cplx {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (p : BringCone R) (a b : R) :
hopf (p * cplx a b) = (a * a + b * b) • hopf p

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.cplx_conj_unitI {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a b : R) :
cplx a b * unitI * star (cplx a b) = (a * a + b * b) • unitI

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.hopf_mul {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (p w : BringCone R) :
hopf (p * w) = p * (w * unitI * star w) * star p

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.cplx_mul_unitI_comm {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a b : R) :
cplx a b * unitI = unitI * cplx a b
